paper_metadata.title: Microstructures and mechanical properties of a commercial pure Zr during rolling and annealing at different temperatures

evidence.quote: the microstructure and mechanical propert y of a commercial pure zirconium during rolling and annealing at different temperatures are investigated

Compared with rolling at room temperature, cryorolling leads to higher degree of inhomogeneous deformation in a commercial pure Zr as results of the increase of the critical resolved shear stress with decreasing temperature, which causes the higher strengt h and good elongation.
Commercial pure Zr plate (Zr702) , with 4.4 mm thickness, was used in the current work. The as-received plate was composed of fully recrystallized microstructure.

Commercial pure Zr plate (Zr702) , with 4.4 mm thickness, was used in the current work. The as-received plate was composed of fully recrystallized microstructure.

Rolling was carried out at room temperature (RT) and liquid nitrogen temperature (LNT). Two reduction levels, 15% and 30%, were applied at each rolling temperature. During rolling, 15% per pass was used.
For the rolling at liquid nitrogen temperature, before each rolling pass, the small plate was immersed in liquid nitrogen for 30 minutes to ensure that the sample was sufficiently cooled.
